description:
Presenting this delightful three-bedroom semi-detached house in the sought-after Belle Vue area. The property features a spacious open plan living dining kitchen space, complemented by a bay fronted living room and a convenient utility room. The first floor boasts a four-piece family bathroom, adding practicality to this charming home.

Outside, you'll find well-maintained gardens to the front and rear, as well as off-street parking for added convenience. The rear garden also includes a generous shed with electricity, perfect for storage or a workshop.

Situated in a popular location close to amenities and the city bypass, this well-presented family home offers easy access to local facilities such as a primary school and a public house. Do not miss out on the opportunity to make this property yours. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and experience the comfort and convenience it has to offer.

Directions Leave Carlisle city centre heading west on Castleway, at the Caldewgate Roundabout take the third exit, continue past the Infirmary, onto Moorhouse Road, the property is located on the right-hand side.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
